A.explanation: Combined regime is dominated by federal exposures: binary passport policy in force after Nov 2025, entry discrepancy leading to refusal and possible lifetime fraud ineligibility, federal facilities bar, and documented immigration/prison custody abuse. Territory adds no documented adult facilities, care or sports ban, and has 2023 hate-crime enhancement, but no comprehensive nondiscrimination coverage beyond government employees and no documented use of enhancement. Protections are partial and contested in litigation, not operative offsets to tier-1 exposures.

entry_documents.exposure: X markers stopped, new passports only M/F per birth documents; existing X valid to expiry; documented confiscation/stranding; entry cable: discrepancy can cause refusal, suspected misrepresentation can support lifetime fraud ineligibility (4 elements, never automatic).
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports remain valid; fraud finding not automatic; ACLU suit pending; several orders enjoined.
entry_documents.interaction: Document discrepancy at entry interacts with fraud ground, detention and custody exposure.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Immigration custody: trans men reported forced labour, beatings, solitary, severe sexual abuse. Federal prisons from 2026: hormone removal, hair cutting, psychiatric substitution described as conversion therapy.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented. No visitor-specific custody protocol documented.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry fraud/detention can lead to immigration custody where abuse documented.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal EO bars trans people from government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity. 21 states/provinces have bans in various scopes; 4 criminalise in certain circumstances; documented 2025 capitol arrest, handcuffed, 24h in men's ward, trespass up to 60 days. Territory-specific adult facilities rule not documented.
federal_state_facilities.protection: 29 states/provinces plus capital district have no ban in mapped categories; territory local ban not documented; trespass requires willful entry plus refusal to depart.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal facilities law applies regardless of local tolerance; state bans compound in many destinations.

care_services.exposure: Federal EO on minor care; proposed rule would bar public insurance under 18; DOJ subpoenaed hospitals for minor records. Territory-specific visitor care access not documented.
care_services.protection: Several federal orders blocked/enjoined; status contested.
care_services.interaction: Record subpoenas and funding threats can chill care even where not finally in force.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: 2025 EO defines sex as binary at birth, mandates sex not gender, removes gender-ideology materials; 2026 counterterrorism strategy prioritises 'radically pro-transgender' groups; 8+ governments issued travel advisories.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: National hate-crime statute covers gender identity; 2020 employment ruling; courts enjoining some orders; suits pending.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: State threat-framing raises outing and enforcement discretion at borders, facilities and checkpoints.

minors_guardians.exposure: Federal directives to investigate/prosecute teachers facilitating social transition; child care banned in 27 states/provinces nationally; sports entry ban. Territory-specific minor care/school rule not documented.
minors_guardians.protection: Not documented for territory; some orders enjoined nationally.
minors_guardians.interaction: Travelling minor faces federal/national climate plus uncertain local school/care rules; guardian/provider liability is traveller-facing exposure.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No territory-specific trans violence rate, police targeting or prosecution record documented. Airport screening can be invasive and outing.
street_violence_police_response.protection: 2023 commonwealth law provides enhanced sentencing for hate crimes motivated by gender identity, but application/prosecutions not documented; federal hate-crime law exists.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Thin local recourse beyond government employees and federal channels leaves remedy uncertain if assault occurs.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport, EO and health rules all in litigation; hate-crime enhancement use not documented; medical requirement for local legal gender change not detailed (resident-facing).
remedies_unknowns.protection: Federal courts, ACLU suit, and 2023 enhancement are documented on paper; operative effectiveness for visitors not documented.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Uncertainty does not mitigate documented entry/facilities/custody exposures.

anchor_checks.comparison: Lower than 0.85: unlike anchor with working protection, this has state-imposed facilities exclusion, birth-sex custody harm and entry fraud risk. Higher than 0.25: no routine police raids/extortion or birth-sex prison housing as universal practice, execution not credible, courts enjoin some measures.

Similar to 0.35: exclusion, humiliation and discretionary refusal rather than likely imprisonment/execution; appeals exist but slow/ineffective for entry/facilities decisions. Custody abuse pushes slightly toward 0.25, injunctions and valid X passports push up.

Below 0.55: 0.55 is mainly delay/secondary screening with working remedies; here discrepancy can cause refusal and possible lifetime ineligibility, facilities bans are criminal in some states, custody abuse documented.

Far below 0.85: 0.85 has recognised documents, training, counsel and tribunal remedy. Here no recognised X for new passports, no visitor facilities protection federally, and no documented operative local remedy.

A.synthesis: Territory tolerance and 2023 hate enhancement do not cancel federal entry, facilities and custody exposures that every visitor passes through. Adult alone faces universal document/facilities exposure with contested remedies and severe custody risk if detained; travelling with a minor adds uncertain but nationally hostile care/school context. No execution or routine imprisonment for identity, so above 0.25, but tier-1 exposures keep it in Elevated Risk.

B.explanation: Same federal tier-1 regime as A, plus documented state/province hostile layers: 2023 school bathroom restriction and minor care ban in force since July 2023, 2022 school sports ban, hate-crime statute expressly excluding gender identity, and RFRA route around local ordinances. 19 municipalities offer some public-accommodations protection and employment rests on appellate/executive sources, but these do not offset federal entry/facilities/custody exposure or state minor bans. Adult alone similar to A; with minor, materially worse.

entry_documents.exposure: Same federal regime: X stopped, M/F per birth documents, confiscation/stranding reported, entry cable refusal on discrepancy and possible lifetime fraud ineligibility for wilful misrepresentation.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X valid to expiry; fraud requires 4 elements, never automatic; litigation pending.
entry_documents.interaction: Federal entry exposure is unaffected by state employment or municipal protections.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Federal immigration custody forced labour, beatings, solitary and sexual abuse reported; federal prison conversion-therapy model from 2026 with hormone removal. Documented trespass arrest held 24h in men's ward (in another state/province example in parent framework).
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented for visitor custody placement.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry investigation or facilities trespass can lead to birth-sex custody exposure.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal facilities bar plus state 2023 K-12 school bathroom restriction for trans students, implemented by districts with April 2023 caution guidance. No state-wide adult bathroom rule documented in this state/province. Nationally 21 states/provinces have varied bans, 4 criminal.
federal_state_facilities.protection: 19 municipalities have local nondiscrimination ordinances including public accommodations; district guidance urges caution; no adult state ban documented.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Adult visitor mainly faces federal/municipal layer; minor student faces state school restriction regardless of municipal protection.

care_services.exposure: State care ban for minors (blockers/hormones) effective 14 July 2023, remained in force on appeal Sep 2023, no phase-out for existing patients. Federal minor-care EO and proposed insurance bar compound.
care_services.protection: Challenges pending; appellate status after Sep 2023 not documented; adult visitor care not documented as banned.
care_services.interaction: Travelling trans minor cannot obtain banned care in state; guardian/provider exposure even if adult visitor is not defendant.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Federal binary-sex EO, gender-ideology removal, 2026 counterterrorism prioritisation of 'radically pro-transgender' groups; state sports ban 2022 and care/school bans enacted over vetoes show hostile state framing.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: National employment appellate ruling 2018 and 2008 executive order for state employees; conversion therapy on minors barred by 2024 executive order.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Hostile framing increases discretion at entry, schools and facilities; efficient state enforcement aggravates, not mitigates, exposure.

minors_guardians.exposure: School bathrooms by birth sex, sports closed to trans girls, minor care ban without phase-out, federal directive to prosecute teachers facilitating social transition. Birth-certificate amendment requires post-operative surgery letter (resident-facing, climate signal only).
minors_guardians.protection: Seven families sued care ban; district caution guidance; no documented exemption for visiting minors.
minors_guardians.interaction: Family travel exposes minor to school exclusion, care denial, forced outing to administrators, and guardian/provider investigation risk.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: State hate-crime statute covers sexual orientation but expressly excludes gender identity, so trans bias violence lacks enhancement. No trans-specific violence statistics documented; do not infer rate.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime law covers gender identity; 2011 sexual-orientation beating led to arrests/guilty pleas with federal/state police.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Gap in state enhancement plus RFRA (2013) undermining local ordinances thins recourse, though federal law remains.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Care ban appellate status after Sep 2023, enforcement frequency of school ban, scope of national employment protection after later litigation, and RFRA application to trans service refusals all not documented.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Courts enjoin some federal orders; municipal ordinances in 19 places; national appellate employment holding. Operative visitor remedy not documented.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Patchwork remedies do not cancel documented state and federal bans; unknowns are not safety.

anchor_checks.comparison: Below 0.55 and near 0.35: state-imposed school facilities/care restrictions and federal entry/custody exposures are tier-1, but no routine raids, extortion, or birth-sex prison housing as documented universal practice and execution not credible, so above 0.25.

Similar to 0.35: discretionary exclusion, detention risk and ineffective/slow remedies rather than likely imprisonment. Extra state minor care/school/sports bans and hate-crime exclusion compound, keeping at low end of this tier.

Below 0.55: 0.55 is administrative delay with appeal desk; here refusal can be permanent fraud ineligibility, facilities use can be trespass, minor care is banned in force, and custody abuse is documented.

Far below 0.85: no recognised nonbinary documents, no facilities equality, no state hate-crime cover for gender identity, and state enacts hostile minor laws over vetoes despite municipal pockets of protection.

B.synthesis: State protections are patchwork and subordinate: municipal ordinances and appellate employment law do not pre-empt federal entry/facilities/custody or state school/care/sports bans. For an adult alone the regime mirrors A; for a family with a minor, in-force care denial, school bathroom restriction and sports exclusion are universal, traveller-facing exposures. That interaction, plus federal custody abuse if detained, places B below A in Elevated Risk, above Severe Risk because imprisonment/execution for identity is not documented as likely.
